Additionally, Edivoxetine is also linked to 3-O-Methyl-beta-D-glucopyranose, which in turn targets SHBG, further supporting a potential role for Edivoxetine in modulating SHBG levels. The evidence is consistent with a mechanism involving receptor-mediated signaling, though the exact nature of the interaction remains unclear.
